annotation.title_clean: Informe de Ponencia Positiva para primer debate al Proyecto de Ley 043 de 2025 Senado - 324 de 2025 Cámara "Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia para garantizar su desarrollo ético, responsable, competitivo e innovador, y se dictan otras disposiciones"
annotation.title_en: Positive Report for First Debate on Bill 043 of 2025 Senate - 324 of 2025 Chamber "Regulating artificial intelligence in Colombia to ensure its ethical, responsible, competitive and innovative development, and other provisions"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República de Colombia (Comisión Sexta Constitucional; ponentes Pedro Hernando Flórez Porras, Gerson Lisímaco Montaño Arizala)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Committee report recommending approval for first debate of Colombia's AI bill (PL 043/2025 Senate, 324/2025 House), with the proposed articles and amendments. It sets a four-tier EU-style risk classification, designates MinCiencias as national AI authority, creates sandboxes, impact assessments, labour transition duties and graduated sanctions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four risk tiers: critical (generally not permitted), high, specific transparency obligations, minimal risk
High-risk list includes AI as safety components of machinery, vehicles and medical devices
MinCiencias is the National AI Authority; creates Intersectoral Committee and Expert Advisory Council
Regulatory sandboxes and mandatory impact assessments for high-risk systems
Sanctions up to 3,000 monthly minimum wages, suspension up to 24 months, closure of systems
